infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RoadEye records forward-facing video of the road surface to detect road damage.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RoadEye records your location while surveying so detected road damage can be placed on a map.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Video recording may capture audio. RoadEye does not analyse audio and it can be disabled in settings.
